latest.title: TypeScript Agents in Production: Frontend, Database, and Everything Between
latest.description: Take a TypeScript AI agent from localhost to production. This post walks through streaming with tool call events, separating auth layers (OAuth public, IAM internal), connecting to PostgreSQL with tenant-isolated typed tools, adding guardrails and cost budgets via lifecycle hooks, wiring up OpenTelemetry observability, and persisting sessions with AgentCore Memory. Uses the Strands Agents TypeScript SDK with Amazon Bedrock. Full sample code included.
